name: teamwork-mcp-server
description: Production-ready MCP server for Teamwork.com task workflows, comments, time logging, and stage moves

scripts.task:create-mock: node --input-type=module -e "import { loadConfig } from './src/config.js'; import { TeamworkClient } from './src/teamworkClient.js'; const client = new TeamworkClient(loadConfig()); const created = await client.createTask({ projectId: 1216946, taskListId: 3691036, title: 'MOCK TASK - MCP stage move validation', description: 'Temporary mock task to validate local MCP stage movement improvements.' }); const taskId = created?.id ?? created?.task?.id ?? created?.TASKID ?? created?.taskId ?? created?.['todo-item']?.id ?? created?.todoItem?.id; console.log(JSON.stringify({ success: true, taskId, created }, null, 2));"
